description: This file defines a script that creates an interactive graphics application using the Love2D or similar framework. It sets up a window and draws a shape based on the mouse position, with a dynamically generated star-like shape using trigonometric functions and randomness.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the application window with a size of 400x400 pixels.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Clears the background and then draws a shape that follows the mouse position, creating a star-like pattern with randomized vertices.
